messages:
eva: alert fired at 02:14 UTC: untagged GPU spend > $8k in project 'orca-research'. see dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/fin/dashboards/orca
sam: who owns orca-research? the project id looks like an R&D sandbox but with customer data.
kevin: that project is used by research for customer pilots. they were running a hyperparameter sweep last night. labels were set at job-level but not VM-level, so billing export shows untagged instances.
eva: image of alert: ``ALERT: untagged_gpu_spend > 8000 on project orca-research`` triggered by cost-detector v2.0
accounting-bot: Automated: Created ticket FIN-5921 for untagged GPU spend. Assigned to finance-lead.
finance-lead: Thanks for the heads up. We need: 1) an immediate backfill of labels for the affected usage window, 2) a decision on whether to invoice the pilot customer or absorb as internal R&D, 3) update the nightly experiment guardrails.
sam: proposal: if the workload is part of a paid pilot, bill to customer; if it was internal research (no signed SOW), absorb up to $5k and mark remainder to research budget. Need product confirmation.
kevin: product confirms this was part of pilot P-ORCA but the SOW allows a capped credit of $3k/month. Anything above should be billable.
eva: estimate total spike: $11,200 across 4 instances between 2026-04-05T01:45 and 2026-04-05T07:30.
sam: can you paste quick CSV for backfill so billing pipeline can ingest?
kevin: here is the CSV I generated from orchestration logs:

resource_name,vm_label_team,vm_label_project,usage_start,usage_end,estimated_cost
orca-sweep-01,research,ORCA-Pilot,2026-04-05T01:45,2026-04-05T04:10,3200
orca-sweep-02,research,ORCA-Pilot,2026-04-05T02:00,2026-04-05T06:00,4100
orca-sweep-03,research,ORCA-Pilot,2026-04-05T03:10,2026-04-05T07:30,3800

accounting-bot: Automated: Backfill ingestion scheduled as JOB-BACKFILL-793; will report status in #billing-updates.
finance-lead: decision: provisional split: absorb $5k internal R&D, bill the pilot customer for $6,200 (subject to legal check and SOW). @kevin please add invoice memo: "Provisional billing for pilot overage - under review".
sam: created a JIRA for process improvements: FIN-5922 - Add VM-level label enforcement and experiment spend cap. ETA: next sprint.
eva: also setting a short-term org policy to block project-level GPU consumption > $10k/day without approval. Pushing policy now.
kevin: started the backfill job and attached run log to FIN-5921. Will tag all billing rows and re-run allocation.
billing-bot: Automated: billing adjustment draft created (ADJ-884) for $6,200 to be invoiced to ORCA Pilot pending approval.
finance-lead: good. Finance will review the draft adjustment and send a pre-bill notice to the pilot contact. Legal, looped in for SOW confirmation.
eva: follow-ups: set alert threshold to $2k untagged in 4h for research projects, add CI check to fail deploys when VM labels omitted, and add this incident to the pricing experiment playbook.
kevin: noted. I'll PR the CI check and update the playbook.
sam: thanks team. keep updates in FIN-5921 and billing-updates.
finance-lead: once adjustment is finalized, I will sign off and route invoice change to accounting.
thread_summary: Untagged GPU spend alert for 'orca-research' pilot; estimated $11.2k spike. Agreed provisional split: $5k internal R&D, $6.2k billed to pilot customer (pending SOW/legal). Actions: backfill VM labels, create billing adjustment, add VM-level label enforcement and experiment spend caps, update playbook and alerts.
